dct_description_sm: This work is part of the Integrated Assessment of Climate Change Impacts and Adaptation Options in Nunavut Communities, co-managed by the Government of Nunavut and Natural Resources Canada.  The direct objective of this project is to identify and categorize landscape hazards in Clyde River, Nunavut.  The depth of the active layer was measured to provide information onto how the landscape will respond to changes in the climate, and the corresponding impact on the integrity of infrastructure.
dct_title_s: Active layer depth data, Clyde River, Nunavut
